It is a real pleasure to participate in the Fifth Meeting of the International Solar Alliance Regional Committee for Europe and the Others Region. 💡

Last year, renewables powered 30% of global electricity, with solar PV leading the charge, representing three-quarters of total capacity additions worldwide. Beyond capacity, we must work towards enhancing access to energy through inclusive reforms that foster a conducive regulatory environment, capacity building, and market integration.

Looking forward to insightful discussions with my friend Ajay Mathur and bringing up actionable steps to scale up #EnergyForDevelopment. ⚡️
